# Zucchini fixture provenance

These fixtures use the BSD-3-Clause terms in `LICENSE`.
`SHA256SUMS` records every binary fixture digest.

The compact `annotation-jvm` DEX pair is retained as a native parity
regression for annotation-heavy JVM metadata.

The NoOp patch is the complete serialized fixture from the pinned upstream `patch_read_write_unittest.cc` field layout used by the Milestone 5a proof.

The DEX and ELF fixtures were generated by the audited proof tooling from:

- AOSP `external/zucchini` at `e256025d9d9c906caba814fd7b99a311ac8b8ec1`
- AOSP `external/libchrome` at `0aba0dccfcd93d8303678a4beb61594f7582c73c`
- Clang 22 for the x86-64 ELF pair

The small DEX files are deterministic DEX 035 files.
The ELF files cover x86, x86-64, AArch32, and AArch64 reference correction.

The large DEX pair contains 65,537 strings, one `const-string` 16-bit reference to index 2, and one `const-string/jumbo` 32-bit reference to index 65,536.
The pair was generated bytewise as DEX 035 and patched with the pinned proof's `GenerateBuffer` fixture tool.
The target changes one same-length string while preserving both code references.
`dex-large-unsafe16.zuc` changes reference-delta entry 5 from encoded zero to encoded `+2`.
This resolves the 16-bit writer to the existing jumbo target at index 65,536 and must fail in preflight.
The expected bytes are stored independently and are not constructed by the adapter tests.

Integration tests wrap canonical `*.zuc` patches with Brotli at runtime.
They use quality 9 and lgwin 20 to match the original fixture-generation settings:

```sh
brotli --quality=9 --lgwin=20 --stdout input.zuc > input.zuc.br
```

Malformed wrapper cases are synthesized in test code from two deterministic inputs:

- raw bytes `not a Brotli stream\n` (intentionally not Brotli), and
- Brotli-compressed bytes of `not a zucchini patch` (valid Brotli, invalid inner patch).
